latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the gstack-review skill for pre-landing PR assessment.

- Analyzes git diffs for SQL safety, LLM trust boundaries, scope drift, missing requirements, and structural issues.
- Implements a two-pass review with critical and informational checks, plus optional frontend and Codex review.
- Applies fix-first workflow: auto-fixes clear issues, batches user questions for others.
- Includes scope drift detection, TODO/documentation cross-referencing, and design review if frontend changes present.
- Provides a structured protocol for completeness and clear user interaction flow.
